Summary A 37-year-old woman was found dead at ION Orchard in Singapore this morning after reports of a fall from height.
 Police were alerted at about 6.50am, and an SCDF paramedic pronounced her dead at the scene.
 Police said preliminary checks do not suggest foul play, and investigations are ongoing.

 Subscribe SINGAPORE, Nov 18 — A 37-year-old woman was found dead at ION Orchard this morning.
 In response to AsiaOne’s queries, the police said they were alerted to a case of a fall from height at 2 Orchard Turn, the address of the shopping mall, at about 6.50am.
 The woman was found lying motionless and was pronounced dead at the scene by a Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) paramedic.
 Police said preliminary investigations do not suggest foul play, and investigations are ongoing. — AsiaOne
